content:
maya: Hey team — thinking about a mid-July rooftop picnic + BYO mic karaoke after work? Weather permitting. Quick poll: which weekday works best for most people? Wed / Thu / Fri? Also food trucks or potluck? :sunglasses: :microphone:

sam: Ooh love this. Thu or Fri for me. Food truck > potluck personally (less Tupperware juggling) :thumbsup:

liam: Friday nights are great. If we do karaoke, can we rent a simple wireless mic? I can look into a cheap setup. 

jen: I'm leaning Wed if we want earlier week vibes, but Friday gets more people. Food truck sounds easiest. Also can we do a non-alcoholic option table (mocktails)? 

maya: Good call jen. We'll plan for mocktails + some alcoholic options if venue allows. Sam, can you flag any dietary needs in the RSVP? I'll make a short form. :memo:

OpsBot: Reminder: rooftop reservation requires Facilities sign-off for groups >20. Please submit form at /facilities/events with "Rooftop Picnic" as title. Deadline to request is 7 days before event.

taylor: I'll volunteer to coordinate music and a short playlist. If people want song requests drop them here like `Artist - Song` and I'll assemble. :notes:

sam: I can handle food trucks — know a vendor who does tacos + veggie options. Will confirm price bracket (~$12-16/person).

liam: Mic rental handled — can pick up and drop off. Price estimate ~$35 for wireless mic for evening. 

jen: RSVP: +1 vegetarian (me), lactose-free option appreciated. Also can bring a few folding chairs if needed. 

maya: Awesome. I'll spin up a one-question RSVP (weekday + coming? + dietary) and post link. Tentative plan: target Fri July 18th 6:30pm, rooftop A. If Facilities vetoes, fallback Thu July 17. Vote here: Wed / Thu / Fri. :ballot_box_with_check:

sam: Voting: Fri

liam: Voting: Fri

jen: Voting: Thu (but can do Fri)

taylor: Voting: Fri

maya: Tally so far — Fri leads. I'll submit Facilities request today and post RSVP link in this thread when ready. If anyone else wants to help with logistics (signage, trash bins, games), shout here. :sparkles:

sam: Happy to help with trash bins & cleanup crew.

liam: I'll bring the mic and cables.

jen: I can handle signage and name tags if useful.

maya: Thanks all! RSVP link: https://forms.redwood.example/r/rooftop-picnic-191987 (please fill out by EOD next Wed). Also drop karaoke song picks below. :microphone: 

taylor: Song pick: "September - Earth, Wind & Fire"

sam: Song pick: "Mr. Brightside - The Killers"

liam: Song pick: "Don't Stop Believin' - Journey"

OpsBot: Facilities form submitted by maya on behalf of channel "lunch-plans". Status: pending review.

maya: End plan for now — will update once Facilities confirms. Thanks for the quick responses :raised_hands:
